title: Often it is not your strategy that loses. It is your broker that wins.
paragraph1: Many traders keep using CFDs out of habit, without noticing that for multi-day or position-style trading the holding cost can mathematically destroy their edge.
paragraph2: At the opposite extreme, high-turnover intraday traders often underestimate how lethal spread can be compared with fixed Futures commissions. If you choose the instrument by habit, you are already accepting avoidable drag.
quote: Broker marketing will not tell you. The numbers will.
card_note: TradeScope moves the discussion away from marketing promise and back to the actual mechanics of cost.
row_1_pattern: A few basis points repeated many times can destroy the edge.
row_2_pattern: Every night adds friction to already amplified capital.
row_3_pattern: Fixed tickets erode risk-reward before the trade can work.
